title: Oklahoma Personnel Act - leave provisions
source_id: Okla. Stat. tit. 74, secs. 840-2.19 to 840-2.24 (within the Oklahoma Personnel Act, secs. 840-1.1 et seq.)
verified_how: queried the Legislature's own statute search twice. For Title 74 and SearchText 'Oklahoma Personnel Act': 8 current sections, the lowest being 74-840-1.1 (the Act's short-title section) and 74-840-1.14. For Title 74 and SearchText 'annual leave': 12 current sections, clustered at 74-840-2.19, 74-840-2.20, 74-840-2.21, 74-840-2.23, 74-840-2.23A, 74-840-2.24 and 74-840-2.30. 'Title 74 - State Government' confirmed on the titles index, currency 'last updated on November 18th, 2025'.
notes: IMPORTANT SCOPE LIMIT: these provisions govern annual, sick and other leave for STATE employees under the state personnel system, not private employers. Oklahoma has no general private-sector paid leave, sick leave or holiday pay statute; private-sector family and medical leave is federal (FMLA, 29 U.S.C. ch. 28). A human should decide whether a state-employee-only provision belongs under this topic.
